DEPARTMENT OF FORENSIC MEDICINE
GOVERNMENT MEDICAL COLLEGE, NAGPUR

P.M. No.: PME-2024/1847
Case No.: CR-156/2024
MLC No.: MLC-2024/3892

Name of Deceased: Rajesh Kumar Sharma
Age: 42 years
Sex: Male

Date of Examination: 15-03-2024
Performed by: Dr. Anita Deshmukh, MD Forensic Medicine

EXTERNAL EXAMINATION:
1. Lacerated wound measuring 6x2x1 cm over the right temporal region.
2. Contusion measuring 4x3 cm over the left forearm.
3. Abrasion measuring 3x2 cm over the right knee.

INTERNAL EXAMINATION:
Brain: Congested. Subdural hemorrhage over right temporal lobe.
Heart: Normal size, weighing 310 grams.
Lungs: Congested and edematous.
Liver: Normal size and consistency.
Kidneys: Normal.
Stomach: Contains partially digested food.

OPINION:
Cause of Death: Craniocerebral damage due to blunt force trauma.
Manner of Death: Homicide
Time of Death: Approximately 12-18 hours prior to post-mortem.

TOXICOLOGY:
Ethanol: Detected (0.08 g/dL)
Opiates: Not detected
Cannabis: Not detected
